about_the_game:
Welcome to Noon Stone

Noon Stone is a roguelite exploration and survival microgame inspired by print & play and tabletop role-playing games (TTRPGs). Your mission: find a lost crystal named Noon Stone, in a hostile world. Every day counts, dangers grow, and enemies become stronger. Will you make the right choices to survive and triumph before it's too late?

Key Features

  • Strategic Exploration: Traverse a procedural map filled with villages, forests, mountains, and swamps.

  • Simple and Effective Combat System: Game-play based on dice rolls, stat management, and equipment.

  • Progression and Survival: Find loot, buy gear, and improve your skills to face increasingly powerful enemies.

  • Unique Aesthetic: A black-and-white world with hand-drawn visuals, inspired by travel journals.

  • Scoring System: Each run is scored, allowing you to challenge yourself and beat your own score.

Game-play Mechanics

  • Hex-based Movement: Each move advances the day, making enemies stronger.

  • Random Encounters: Every tile may hold an enemy, a village, a market, a clue, or a surprise.

  • Combat System: Dice-based battles with stats like attack, defense, health, and equipment.

  • Taverns & Shops: Buy equipment, sell loot, and gather clues about the crystal's location.

Are You Ready for the Challenge?

Every play-through is different, and every decision matters. Will you dare to take on Noon Stone and uncover its secrets?

Add Noon Stone to your wishlist and get ready for adventure!
